task_description: Move the Discord bot's story prologue from an in-place ephemeral embed to a multi-message DM conversation (plain text for conversation scenes, embeds kept for map and the book's card grid), with a precise stale-button safety model; add a command-layer ready-gate before the greeting and resume prompts that persist nothing on decline; add /invite (any user), other-player read-only /profile and /collection, and an owner-gated /admin summary; add a PlayerRepo enumeration method; update the story design doc.
